statement: FARO Lab scores are speculative directional compatibility prototypes, NOT a live surf-quality forecast or a safe-entry determination.

CL-VS:la-boca-concon.name: La Boca · Concón
CL-VS:la-boca-concon.tideReference: All tides reported by a guide; response of individual sandbanks remains uncalibrated.
CL-VS:la-boca-concon.hazardContextEs: Desembocadura con corrientes, cambios de bancos y restricciones ambientales en el humedal. No interpretar el score como autorización de acceso.
CL-VS:la-boca-concon.hazardContextEn: River mouth with currents, changing sandbanks and wetland restrictions. A score is not an access clearance.

CL-VS:ritoque.name: Ritoque · picos norte
CL-VS:ritoque.tideReference: Medium–low reported; not applied without measured local tide/bank response.
CL-VS:ritoque.hazardContextEs: La zona norte tiene canales de entrada; hacia el sur la exposición y remada cambian. Revisar bancos y corrientes.
CL-VS:ritoque.hazardContextEn: The northern zone has channels; exposure and paddling change towards the south. Check sandbanks and currents.

CL-VS:renaca.name: Reñaca · picos norte
CL-VS:renaca.tideReference: Medium–low reported for northern peaks, not an entire-beach validated tide response.
CL-VS:renaca.hazardContextEs: Las secciones norte y sur difieren; el swell puede intensificar corrientes. Verificar la rompiente.
CL-VS:renaca.hazardContextEn: Northern and southern sections differ; swell can strengthen currents. Verify the surf locally.
